Confirmed findings

QA-001mediumconfirmed

Penang destination results repeatedly return HTTP 503

http://localhost:3000/

Impact
Users cannot browse Penang properties through the Discover destination selector.
Severity rationale
The Penang browse path is unavailable, but other destinations remain usable; impact is localized to users seeking Penang stays.
Expected
Penang results should load or the UI should show a genuine no-results state rather than a service-unavailable failure.
Expected basis
Penang is a visible destination option and a Penang property (The George) is shown in the default collection; comparison destinations load normally.
Actual
Three Penang selections returned HTTP 503. The UI showed a temporary-unavailability alert and no matching cards.
Comparison / uncertainty
Kuala Lumpur returned two stays, Langkawi three, and Cameron Highlands two. Root cause not established.

Reproduction

  1. Open Discover.
  2. Select Penang in Destination.
  3. Observe Results unavailable and HTTP 503.
  4. Repeat the same selection; compare with Langkawi or Cameron Highlands.

Attempts: 3; reproduced: 3; confidence: high.

Recommendation: Restore the Penang listing endpoint and verify the destination option against the available Penang stay record; retain the visible recoverable error state for genuine outages.

QA-002mediumconfirmed

The Moss House quote accepts more guests than its stated room limit

http://localhost:3000/#/hotel/moss-house

Impact
Guests may receive a quote and proceed with an occupancy the property explicitly says it cannot accommodate.
Severity rationale
A single property's quote allows a party above its stated maximum, which can produce an invalid reservation attempt; users can avoid the issue by selecting four or fewer guests.
Expected
Guest options and quote validation must prevent or reject a party larger than four for one room.
Expected basis
The detail page states Up to 4 guests and A maximum of 4 guests.
Actual
The selector offers 5 and 6; selecting 6 generated a successful quote (RM 3,726.00 for three nights) and left Continue to reservation available.
Comparison / uncertainty
Serena Villas also states a four-guest maximum; no over-capacity check was performed there. Root cause not established.

Reproduction

  1. Open The Moss House detail.
  2. Select six guests, or arrive from Discover with six selected.
  3. Observe the quote and Continue to reservation control.

Attempts: 2; reproduced: 2; confidence: high.

Recommendation: Constrain the detail selector to the room's maximum and enforce the same limit in quote validation before enabling reservation continuation.

Limitations and next checks

Limitations

  • Assessment is partial; authenticated workflows remain untested because no test account was supplied.
  • Reservation continuation, account-specific saved stays/bookings, and any payment stage were not attempted.
  • House rules disclosure was discovered but not opened.
  • Date/guest availability search behavior is unclear; the primary button scrolled to the destination-filtered collection and no separate results route was observed.
  • Performance was not measured; available network listings did not expose durations.
  • Accessibility coverage was sampled only; no WCAG conformance claim is made.
  • The supplied HTML report template contains only a run-details/footer fragment (19 lines). The report uses that run-details design, the supplied CSS, and the Markdown template's section outline.

Prioritized next checks

  1. With a designated test account, verify sign-in, saved-stay persistence, bookings, and reservation continuation without completing a real payment.
  2. Investigate the Penang endpoint's repeated HTTP 503 using the app's service logs/correlation data; compare the Penang record path with working destinations.
  3. Enforce The Moss House's four-guest maximum in the selector and quote validation; verify the reservation step rejects over-capacity inputs.
  4. Clarify whether Discover dates and guest count are intended to drive availability search; test that contract once established.
  5. Open and review the House rules & cancellation policy disclosure and sample keyboard navigation through detail controls.
